fact: INSS says its SISSMO social-security information system was conceived in 2010 by a Brazilian consortium, TopDown, and that the consultants who designed it were contracted again for its maintenance and evolution, with the Brazilian firm Integral Sistemas to do the work.
title: INSS procura adequar o SISSMO à dinâmica do mercado
publisher: INSS - Instituto Nacional de Segurança Social de Moçambique
